تلتمسون (form VIII)
# تَلْتَمِسُونَ (taltamisūna) /tal.ta.mi.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
# تُلْتَمَسُونَ (tultamasūna) /tul.ta.ma.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَمَسَ (iltamasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
